instruction: A foggy Victorian street at night: rows of glowing gas lamps fading into the mist, wet cobblestones, brick townhouses with bay windows and chimney stacks, a horse-drawn carriage with lantern, an iron fence around a small square, a red pillar postbox, a distant clock tower with a lit face, and drifting fog banks between the lamps.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Victorian Gaslamp Street. A foggy Victorian street at night: rows of glowing gas lamps fading into the mist, wet cobblestones, brick townhouses with bay windows and chimney stacks, a horse-drawn carriage with lantern, an iron fence around a small square, a red pillar postbox, a distant clock tower with a lit face, and drifting fog banks between the lamps. Style: foggy victorian. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
